acceptanceCriteria: dogfood check finds the previous CEM base from a compact cem/1.0 sidecar (decode through the stable reader or a layout-independent capture) and the unbound-commits check reports an outcome, not previous-cem-base-unavailable, on a stable lane
script/dogfood-bind-range_test.sh fakes write the cem/1.0 compact layout; the 0.x fake layout is removed
a maintained test in internal/dogfoodflow covers the compact sidecar; build-log entry records the change
body: Confirmed bug. internal/dogfoodflow/check.go line 284 defines cemBaseRevisionRE as ^  "baseRevision": "([0-9a-f]{40})",$ (two-space indented, trailing comma), and line 896 applies it to the previous sidecar to find the prior CEM base for the unbound-commits check. The stable cem/1.0 encoder writes a compact sidecar with no indentation, so the capture never matches and dogfood-check reports NOTE unbound-commits NOT_OBSERVED previous-cem-base-unavailable on every stable lane. Observed again on the V1-1278 S2a bind (PR beamfall/corvint#851, seal 52af6ee1; see the s2 dogfood logs under the orchestrator scratchpad agent-1278/dogfood-s2/). The S2a builder tried a port and reverted it because the script/dogfood-bind-range_test.sh fakes still write the 0.x pretty layout, so the fix needs the fakes updated together with the regex (or a decode of the sidecar through the stable reader instead of a regex). Since all committed maps are cem/1.0 after V1-1277, the 0.x branch of the regex is dead.
title: dogfood check: cemBaseRevisionRE matches only the 0.x two-space sidecar, so every compact cem/1.0 sidecar yields unbound-commits NOT_OBSERVED previous-cem-base-unavailable
